brief: Run Toward the Light — English male rock anthem. 120 seconds, approximately 132 BPM, 4/4. Electric guitars, bass, live drums and restrained organ. Quiet determination in the verse, rising pre-chorus, powerful sung chorus and a brief guitar response. Motivational without generic slogans or constant shouting. Hook: “One more step into the light / I’m still here, I’m still in the fight”.

lyrics.text:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Cold coffee on the windowsill
Taped-up knuckles, standing still
Rain on the tin roof, boots by the door
Mud on my jeans from the night before

[Pre-Chorus]
Dust on my tongue and the crowd walking out
I tie my laces slow, no room for doubt

[Chorus]
One more step into the light
I’m still here, I’m still in the fight
Knees in the gravel, but I rise slow
Every heartbeat tells me where to go

[Verse 2]
Morning finds me on the cinder track
Same worn shoes, but I’m not looking back
Dad’s old voice is crackling on the phone
Says the porch light’s on, you’re not alone

[Pre-Chorus]
Dust on my tongue and the crowd walking out
I tie my laces slow, no room for doubt

[Chorus]
One more step into the light
I’m still here, I’m still in the fight
Knees in the gravel, but I rise slow
Every heartbeat tells me where to go

[Bridge]
I stopped counting all the times I fell
Started counting sunrises as well
Who I was is a shadow on the wall
Who I am is just getting up, that’s all

[Chorus]
One more step into the light
I’m still here, I’m still in the fight
Knees in the gravel, but I rise slow
Every heartbeat tells me where to go

[Outro]
lyrics.topic: Someone keeps going after being knocked down: quiet determination, specific images of the struggle, no generic slogans; the chorus is sung with power, not shouted.
